step1.title: This is where you play
step1.body: Pro Fantasy is three games to compete with your friends all season long. Here's a 30-second tour.

step2.title: Fantasy
step2.body: Create your private league, split the players in a live draft and score points from what they do each round.

step3.title: Pools
step3.body: Predict the exact score of every match in the round and compete for first place in your group.

step4.title: Survivor
step4.body: Pick a team every round and survive. Each team can only be used once — stay alive as long as you keep getting it right.

step5.title: League results
step5.body: The Results tab has your league's table, fixtures, statistics and transfers.

step6.title: Getting around
step6.body: Use the bottom bar to jump between Play, Results and Leagues, and open your profile from the top.

step1.title: Your pool
step1.body: Here you predict match scores and compete for first place against the rest of the participants.

step2.title: Info, Predictions and Standings
step2.body: Use the top tabs to switch between the pool's info, your predictions and the group standings.

step3.title: Make your predictions
step3.body: In Predictions, adjust each match score with the + and − buttons. It saves automatically.

step4.title: Compete and invite
step4.body: Check your position in the Standings and share the access code to invite your friends.
